name: Gasthof Au
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated with panoramic scenery in Ellmau, Gasthof Au offers cosy guestrooms alongside hearty inn fare. It is an ideal holiday setting for summer hiking and winter skiing.

The Hartkaiser cable car, KaiserBad Ellmau swimming center, and SkiWelt access are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Au in Ellmau delights guests with traditional Tyrolean comfort and vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.
